# ECN-2026-032 - Change notice - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Reason for change
- Background: During a recent review of maintenance and measurement accuracy for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02), traceability gaps were identified between field calibration activities and the calibration records retained in the document control system. Field technicians reported inconsistent reminder scheduling for thermocouple calibrations; maintenance work orders referenced different intervals across MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1. The inconsistency increases risk of out-of-tolerance thermocouples being used in production, which can affect furnace control and part quality.
- Purpose: Standardize the thermocouple calibration interval and the procedural flow for scheduling, performing, and recording calibrations on EQ-P2-L2-HT02 to ensure measurement integrity and audit readiness.
- Rationale: A single, documented calibration interval removes ambiguity for maintenance scheduling, improves consistency of measurements used by furnace control systems, and streamlines records management. Aligning the work instructions and maintenance task lists reduces duplicate entries and missed calibrations.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02 (Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2) — applies to all thermocouples installed on the equipment control loops and any portable thermocouple probes used for verification on this asset.
- Procedures and maintenance documents: MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, SOP-P2-L2-04 are to be updated to reflect the revised calibration control flow and the standardized thermocouple calibration interval.
- Records: Calibration certificates, maintenance task completion records, calibration reminder logs, and calibration verification checklists associated with EQ-P2-L2-HT02.

Change detail and implementation
- Specification update: The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 40 days. This interval is the required scheduling cadence for all calibrated thermocouples assigned to EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and is to be entered verbatim into maintenance planning systems and checklists.
- Procedure alignment:
  - MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 will be revised to contain a single, clear maintenance task item specifying the calibration interval as 40 days for thermocouples used on EQ-P2-L2-HT02. Task descriptions will include acceptance criteria, required tools, and the referenced calibration method in SOP-P2-L2-04.
  - SOP-P2-L2-04 will be updated to include the method for performing thermocouple calibration checks for EQ-P2-L2-HT02, references to the calibration interval of 40 days, and the documentation requirements listed below.
- Scheduling and notification:
  - Maintenance planners shall schedule thermocouple calibration tasks for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 to occur with the cadence of 40 days, using the electronic maintenance system. Work orders must cite MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 as the controlling maintenance procedures and SOP-P2-L2-04 as the calibration method.
- Execution steps (summary):
  - Verify identity of the thermocouple or probe against the equipment tag on EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
  - Perform calibration per SOP-P2-L2-04. Use the acceptance criteria in MM-P2-L2-HT02.
  - If the thermocouple passes, complete the calibration certificate and upload to the calibration database, citing the calibration interval of 40 days and referencing MM-P2-L2-HT02.
  - If the thermocouple fails, follow the disposition steps in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 and initiate replacement or rework. Record the nonconformance and the corrective action taken.
- Examples:
  - Example maintenance task entry: "Thermocouple calibration – EQ-P2-L2-HT02 – Interval: 40 days – Procedure: MM-P2-L2-HT02 – Method: SOP-P2-L2-04."
  - Example record notation: "Calibration result: PASS; Interval cited: 40 days; Source procedure: MM-P2-L2-HT02; Method: SOP-P2-L2-04."
- Records to keep:
  - Calibration certificates for each thermocouple on EQ-P2-L2-HT02, with explicit notation that the thermocouple calibration interval is 40 days.
  - Maintenance work order completion records that reference MM-P2-L2-HT02 and MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 as applicable.
  - Calibration reminder log or maintenance system task history showing scheduled and completed calibrations at the 40 days cadence.
  - Any nonconformance reports and corrective actions arising from failed calibrations, with linkage to the replacement part record for the thermocouple.
  - Signed review of procedure updates indicating the incorporation of the 40 days calibration interval into MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, and SOP-P2-L2-04.

Transition plan and verification
- Effective implementation requires updates to the three cited documents. Document revisions will be issued to maintenance and operations prior to enforcement.
- A transitional audit will be performed after the first full cycle post-implementation to verify that scheduled tasks reflect the calibration interval of 40 days and that records are being completed and uploaded as specified.
- Any deviations discovered during the transition audit will trigger a corrective action referenced to MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1.

Approvals
- Approval signatures shall be recorded on this ECN and retained in the document control system. The approval package shall include confirmation that MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, and SOP-P2-L2-04 have been updated to reflect the thermocouple calibration interval of 40 days and that training notices have been distributed to affected staff.
- Required approvers will include maintenance management, quality assurance, and the asset owner for EQ-P2-L2-HT02. Approved copies of the revised MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, and SOP-P2-L2-04 must be attached to the ECN record.

Change control notes
- Do not alter the calibration interval for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 outside of an approved ECN. Any request to change the thermocouple calibration interval must reference this ECN and provide justification, impact assessment, and updated procedural text for MM-P2-L2-HT02, MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, and SOP-P2-L2-04.
- Retain all prior calibration records for audit traceability and include cross-reference to this ECN in the file index.

Related documents
- MM-P2-L2-HT02
- MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1
- SOP-P2-L2-04
